comparison.objective: Move an untaped-bottom carton of cans onto a shelf without losing its contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Discover and continuously support hinged bottom flaps from below while carrying and placing the carton bimanually.
comparison.success_condition: All cans remain inside throughout, and the carton is released upright and stable on the shelf; any escaped can permanently scores zero.
comparison.reason: Continuous load support during transport is unrelated to coupled rotary adjustment, countertorque locking, and functional cycling.
